Container.Name: motion-scan
Container.Overview:
Scans a folder of security-camera MKV/MP4 files and classifies each one as "motion" or "no_motion" by sampling frames and measuring frame-to-frame pixel difference, so you can review/delete the no-motion clips. This is a one-shot batch job, not a persistent service: hit Start, watch the log, it exits when done and writes a CSV back into the video folder.
NOTE: There is no public registry image -- build it locally on this Unraid box first, from the motion-scan-tools folder: `docker build -f Dockerfile.qsv -t motion-scan:latest .` -- then install this template.
MODE=dense uses hardware-accelerated decode (HWACCEL: qsv/vaapi/cuda/none) sampled at FPS. MODE=fast is CPU-only and decodes only keyframes -- much faster, no GPU/device needed, good as a first pass or if /dev/dri isn't cooperating. For QuickSync on Arrow Lake/Meteor Lake etc., try HWACCEL=qsv first, fall back to HWACCEL=vaapi if it errors.
Container.Requires: Build the image locally first (see Overview) -- no registry to pull from.

Config.Name: Videos Folder
Config.Description: Folder of MKV/MP4 files to scan. The results CSV is written back into this same folder.

Config.Name: /dev/dri (QuickSync)
Config.Description: Intel iGPU render node, needed for HWACCEL=qsv or HWACCEL=vaapi. Not needed for MODE=fast or HWACCEL=none/cuda.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: 'dense' = hardware-decoded, sampled at FPS (higher fidelity, needs HWACCEL). 'fast' = CPU-only, keyframes only (much faster, no GPU needed).

Config.Name: Hardware Accel
Config.Description: Only used when MODE=dense: qsv (Intel QuickSync via oneVPL), vaapi (Intel QuickSync via VA-API, fallback if qsv errors), cuda (NVIDIA NVDEC), or none (software).

Config.Name: Workers
Config.Description: Concurrent ffmpeg processes. QSV/VAAPI/CPU can go fairly high; consumer NVIDIA GPUs cap concurrent NVDEC sessions (~3-5) if you ever use HWACCEL=cuda here.

Config.Name: Sample FPS
Config.Description: Frames/sec sampled in dense mode. Higher = more accurate motion detection, slower.

Config.Name: Diff Threshold
Config.Description: Mean abs pixel diff (0-255 grayscale) that counts a sampled frame pair as 'changed'. Raise if camera sensor noise causes false 'motion' classifications.

Config.Name: Motion Fraction Threshold
Config.Description: Fraction of changed frame pairs needed to classify a file as 'motion' rather than 'no_motion'.

Config.Name: Scale Width
Config.Description: Downscale width used for frame-diffing. Smaller = faster.

Config.Name: Recursive
Config.Description: Scan subfolders of the Videos Folder too.

Config.Name: Per-file Timeout (sec)
Config.Description: Kill and mark 'error' if a single file's ffmpeg pass takes longer than this.

Config.Name: VA-API Device
Config.Description: Render node to use when HWACCEL=vaapi. List candidates with `ls /dev/dri` in the Unraid console if renderD128 isn't right.

Config.Name: Output CSV Filename
Config.Description: Leave blank to auto-name (e.g. dense_results_qsv.csv). Written into the Videos Folder.
